clue.mod-stella-ruins.proving_grounds: Where the crowd is dust, a gong still calls the brave. Ring it, choose your trial, and prove yourself wave on wave.
effect.mod-stella-ruins.crowd: Each consecutive hit adds 6% damage, up to 5 stacks. 60 ticks without a hit reset it.
message.mod-stella-ruins.proving_grounds: The grounds are still waking. Come closer.
The gong rings out. Pick a tier at a lectern.
Rest, champion. This tier paid out today.
The crowd roars. The contest begins.
The crowd is on its feet. The tier is yours.
The crowd boos. The tier is lost.
